take.title_zh: 當 Agent 拿到鑰匙：信任成為設計題
take.title_en: Agents Get the Keys, Trust Becomes a Design Problem
take.body_zh:
本期的共同線索是「權限」。Apple 以 AI agent 風險為由收緊 macOS Full Disk Access，AI 助理則直接住進簡訊對話框；白宮同時找來科技巨頭簽署安全承諾，OpenAI 又有安全員工公開離職。Agent 能做的事越多，誰授權、授權多少、怎麼撤回，就越不是工程細節。

對設計師與 PM 來說，這代表權限對話框、操作紀錄、可逆性與「Agent 正在做什麼」的可視化，會從邊角 UI 變成核心體驗。值得現在就盤點：你的產品若被 agent 操作，使用者看得懂、停得下來嗎？
take.body_en:
The common thread this issue is permissions. Apple is tightening macOS Full Disk Access over AI-agent risk, assistants are moving into text threads, the White House gathered tech CEOs for a safety pledge, and another OpenAI safety employee walked out publicly.

For designers and PMs, permission prompts, activity logs, reversibility and visible agent status are shifting from edge-case UI to the core experience. Worth auditing now: if an agent operates your product, can users understand it and stop it?

articles.title_zh: 白宮集結科技 CEO 簽 AI 安全承諾，並把 AI 改稱「超級智慧」
articles.title_en: White House Gets Tech CEOs to Sign AI Safety Pledge, Rebrands AI as 'Super Intelligence'
articles.summary_zh: 白宮本週把 Zuckerberg、Bezos、Musk 與 Anthropic 的 Dario Amodei 等主要科技 CEO 聚集一堂，簽署一份 AI 安全承諾，川普稱其具「道德約束力」而非法律約束。川普同時簽署行政命令，正式將 AI 改稱為「super intelligence」。TechCrunch 節目也點出，Meta 與 OpenAI 正為 AI 產品換上更親民的形象，而資金仍持續大量湧入。
articles.summary_en: This week the White House put nearly every major tech CEO in one room — Zuckerberg, Bezos, Musk and Anthropic's Dario Amodei among them — to sign an AI safety pledge that President Trump called "morally binding." Trump also signed an executive order officially rebranding AI as "super intelligence." TechCrunch's discussion also notes that Meta and OpenAI are putting friendlier faces on their AI products while the money keeps flowing.
articles.take_zh: 「道德約束」意味著沒有罰則，實際規範仍要看各公司自律。但命名本身就是設計：當官方語彙變成「超級智慧」，使用者對 AI 能力的期待與恐懼都會被放大，產品文案與預期管理需要更謹慎。
articles.take_en: A "morally binding" pledge has no teeth, so real guardrails still sit with each company. But naming is design: an official shift to "super intelligence" inflates both user expectations and fears, so product copy and expectation-setting need extra care.

articles.title_zh: OpenAI 安全員工辭職，直言公司「文化已經壞了」
articles.title_en: OpenAI Safety Employee Resigns, Saying the Company's 'Culture Is Broken'
articles.summary_zh: 上期報導 WSJ 揭露 OpenAI 與三名安全研究員切割後，事件出現新進展：安全團隊成員 David Robinson 宣布辭職，並公開表示 OpenAI 的「文化已經壞了」。他自嘲自己是「某種陳腔濫調」——又一位在離職時發出嚴厲警告的 AI 公司員工。接連的人事變動讓外界對 OpenAI 安全治理的疑慮持續升溫。
articles.summary_en: A follow-up to last issue's WSJ report that OpenAI cut ties with three safety researchers: safety staffer David Robinson has now resigned, publicly claiming the company's "culture is broken." By his own admission he is "something of a cliché" — another AI-lab employee issuing a dire warning on the way out. The back-to-back departures keep pressure on questions about OpenAI's safety governance.
articles.take_zh: 單一離職信影響有限，但連續事件會累積成品牌信任問題。對以 OpenAI 模型打造產品的團隊，值得留意供應商的安全治理，並在產品端保留自己的防護與替代方案。
articles.take_en: One resignation letter changes little; a pattern becomes a brand-trust issue. Teams building on OpenAI models should watch vendor safety governance and keep their own guardrails and fallback options in the product layer.

articles.title_zh: 盤點：可以住進你簡訊裡的 AI Agent
articles.title_en: All the AI Agents That Can Live in Your Text Messages
articles.summary_zh: TechCrunch 整理了目前最值得注意、可以直接在簡訊中使用的 AI agent，從通用型助理，到專為家庭、旅遊與工作情境設計的 agent 都有。這類產品不需要使用者下載新 App 或學習新介面，而是把 AI 放進大家每天已經在用的對話框，透過傳訊息就能交辦任務、取得回覆。
articles.summary_en: TechCrunch rounds up the most notable AI agents that work inside your text messages, from general-purpose assistants to agents built for families, travel and work. Instead of asking users to download yet another app or learn a new interface, these products drop AI into the messaging thread people already use daily — you text a request and the agent replies or acts.
articles.take_zh: 「沒有介面」本身就是介面設計。簡訊 agent 把 onboarding、狀態回饋、錯誤處理全壓進純文字對話，設計師需要思考：沒有按鈕與視覺層級時，如何讓使用者知道 agent 能做什麼、做到哪一步。
articles.take_en: No UI is still a UI decision. SMS agents squeeze onboarding, status and error handling into plain text — designers must figure out how users learn what the agent can do and where a task stands without buttons or visual hierarchy.

articles.title_zh: Apple 因 AI Agent 風險，收緊 macOS「完整磁碟取用權限」
articles.title_en: Apple Tightens macOS 'Full Disk Access' Controls Over AI-Agent Risks
articles.summary_zh: Apple 宣布將為 macOS 的 Full Disk Access 權限加入新的控制機制，理由是能力越來越強的 AI agent，讓「廣泛存取使用者檔案、訊息、郵件與瀏覽紀錄」這件事風險大增。過去只要使用者一次授權，App 就能讀取大量個人資料；Apple 認為在 agent 時代，這種寬鬆授權模式需要重新設計。
articles.summary_en: Apple says it will add new controls around macOS's Full Disk Access permission, warning that increasingly capable AI agents make broad access to users' files, messages, mail and browsing history riskier. A single grant used to unlock a huge swath of personal data; Apple is signaling that this all-or-nothing permission model needs rethinking in the agent era.
articles.take_zh: 平台層開始為 agent 重畫權限邊界。做桌面 AI 工具的團隊要預期授權流程變長、變細，及早設計「最小必要權限」與清楚的授權說明，避免在新規則上路後轉換率崩跌。
articles.take_en: Platforms are redrawing permission boundaries for agents. Teams shipping desktop AI tools should expect longer, finer-grained consent flows and design least-privilege access and clear permission copy now, before new rules dent activation.

articles.title_zh: Meta 想讓你的下一個裝置都內建 Muse
articles.title_en: Meta Wants Your Next Gadget to Be Muse-Infused
articles.summary_zh: Meta 希望把自家 AI Muse 放進電視、甚至烤麵包機等各種裝置，為此選擇免費釋出相關程式碼，讓開發者與硬體廠商自行打造搭載 Muse 的產品。這延續 Meta 以開放策略擴大生態系的路線：與其自己做所有硬體，不如讓 Muse 成為各種裝置的預設 AI 層。
articles.summary_en: Meta wants Muse in your TV and your toaster, so it's giving the code away for free, letting developers and hardware makers build their own Muse-powered gadgets. It extends Meta's open playbook: rather than building every device itself, it aims to make Muse the default AI layer across a broad ecosystem of third-party hardware.
articles.take_zh: AI 從螢幕走向家電，介面會變成語音、燈號、實體按鈕的組合。設計師可以開始累積「無螢幕 AI 互動」的模式語言，這會是下一波硬體專案的關鍵能力。
articles.take_en: As AI moves from screens into appliances, the interface becomes voice, lights and physical controls. Designers should start building a pattern library for screenless AI interaction — it'll be core to the next wave of hardware work.

articles.title_zh: 教宗良十四世：AI 生成圖像不是藝術
articles.title_en: Pope Leo XIV Is Not a Fan of AI-Generated Art
articles.summary_zh: 教宗良十四世公開表態反對 AI 生成藝術。他寫道，藝術與機器透過「統計運算、以他人創作的數百萬張圖像為基礎」所生成的東西之間，在美學差異之前就先存在「本體論上的差異」，並直言「演算法缺乏人性的火花」。這是宗教領袖對生成式 AI 創作議題最直接的發言之一。
articles.summary_en: Pope Leo XIV came out against AI-generated art, writing that there is "an ontological difference, even before an aesthetic one, between art and what a machine can generate through statistical calculation based on millions of images created by others." "Algorithms lack the spark of humanity," he added — one of the most direct statements yet from a global religious leader on generative creative work.
articles.take_zh: 「以他人作品訓練」這句話直指創作者最在意的授權與署名問題。對設計團隊而言，在作品中如何揭露 AI 參與、如何標示來源，正從倫理討論變成品牌信任議題。
articles.take_en: "Based on millions of images created by others" goes straight at creators' core grievance: consent and credit. For design teams, how you disclose AI involvement and attribute sources is shifting from an ethics debate to a brand-trust issue.

articles.title_zh: Laytr 新 App：不只文章，網路上任何東西都能存起來
articles.title_en: Laytr's New App Lets You Save Anything You Find Online
articles.summary_zh: 新 App Laytr 想做「稍後閱讀」的升級版：不只能存文章，也能收藏食譜、截圖、影片、PDF 等各種網路內容，並在使用者的 Apple 裝置間同步，同時強調封存資料保持私密。它瞄準的是使用者收藏內容散落在各 App、事後難以找回的日常痛點。
articles.summary_en: Laytr is pitching a broader take on read-it-later: save articles, recipes, screenshots, videos, PDFs and more, synced across your Apple devices while keeping your archive private. It targets the everyday pain of saved content being scattered across a dozen different apps.
articles.take_zh: 「什麼都能存」的難點不在收，而在找。這類產品的成敗取決於分類、搜尋與回顧機制的設計，值得 PM 觀察它如何處理異質內容的資訊架構。
articles.take_en: The hard part of "save anything" isn't saving — it's finding. Success hinges on organization, search and resurfacing design; worth watching how Laytr handles information architecture for wildly mixed content types.
